header.title: Command interception
header.subtitle: Tools are matched against interception rules before execution; unmatched commands can be judged by the model fallback

scope.label: Interception scope
scope.empty: No tools enabled — neither interception rules nor the model fallback take effect
scope.dialogDescription: Only tools with interception enabled go through rule matching; all other tools pass through directly

rules.hint: Rules are matched one by one in priority order (higher numbers first); the first match wins

editor.description: Higher priority matches first; the first matching rule wins and the rest are skipped
editor.regexWarn: Contains Go RE2 extended syntax (e.g. (?i)); the browser cannot preview it, and the server validates on submission
editor.argvHelp: JSON array of 1 to 8 tokens: the program and its subcommands, no flags. Matches a single simple Bash command whose prefix is exactly {prefix}. Flags are not constrained: ["git","push"] also covers git push --force.
editor.policyAllow: Allow — pass through directly, skipping the remaining rules
editor.policyDeny: Block — cut it off and return a denial message to the model
editor.policyAsk: Ask the user — wait for approval
editor.timeoutEnableHint: Handle automatically after the timeout instead of waiting

judge.title: Model fallback approval
judge.description: Only commands inside the <scope>interception scope</scope> that <rule>match no interception rule</rule> are semantically judged by the model (allow / escalate to human / block)

toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load model fallback config: {message}

usage.title: Approval token consumption
usage.subtitle: Cumulative model fallback approval usage, metered separately (worker=judge), not mixed with per-model config stats
usage.dailyLabel: Daily consumption over the last 30 days (input + output)

promptSection.title: Approval prompt
promptSection.subtitle: The model decides ALLOW / ASK / DENY based on this; directly editable
promptSection.placeholder: Leave empty to use the built-in template

policy.heading: Judge model and policy
policy.modeClosed: Closed questions (code decides; prompt is the operator policy; failure asks)
policy.failLabel: When the model fails (error / timeout / unparsable)

header.title: Asset interception
header.subtitle: Global asset blocklist: matching domains / IPs / URLs / networks are intercepted; no operations run against them

assets.intro: Supports exact and fuzzy matching for domains / IPs / URLs, plus CIDR networks; ships with built-in fuzzy blocks for government (.gov / .gov.cn) and education (.edu / .edu.cn) sites
assets.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete asset interception rule "{pattern}"?

toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load asset interception rules

editor.description: Target assets matching this rule are intercepted globally
editor.hintFuzzy: Fuzzy match: hits when the target contains this content
editor.hintExact: Exact match: the target must equal this content exactly
